utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: Well, that's hard. It takes a lot of practice to do that.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Here?

utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: We'll get you a little special fishing rod for little kids. This is a big— for big people, for grandpas. But we'll get you a special one like that. We'll get you a—

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Can I get a Pop It one? I want it to be a Pop It Troll.

utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: A 'Pop It'? Is that a new kind of lure, honey? You don't want to be popping the line too hard or you'll lose the fish.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: No, Grandpa! Pop Its! Like the fidget toys. The ones that go 'pop pop'. It’s the brand!

utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: Oh! A toy brand. I thought you were telling me how to fix the reel. Well, I’m clearly behind the times. We'll get you a Frozen fishing pole or Pop It Troll or something like that fishing pole, and then you can cast it. You can throw it out there, okay?

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Okay. So this is for Grandpa?

utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: Yeah, it'll be easier. That's for Grandpa, yeah, or Uncle Brian. So those are a little harder to throw out there. You're going the wrong way again, dear. Gotta go tighten it up.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Oh yeah, tighten it up. Where's yours?

utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: Where's mine? Yeah, right there. You're using mine. No, Uncle's. Uncle? That's Uncle's too. I think that one's Uncle's. Mine's in the shed.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Yours in the shed?

utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: Yeah, we're just borrowing Uncle Brian's right now.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: You guys found something! I found something! I found something!

utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: Let's throw it back out. Okay, you throw it back out.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: I'll throw it back out and you bring it back in, okay? How far can I go?

utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: There!

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Whoa!

utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: Do it again!

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: That went far!

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Yeah, I know.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Here?

utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: Yeah
